description: Fetch one item from a Zas channel. A note comes back as text; a file is written to disk. Returns the path written; it can differ from `dest` when a file with that name already exists. Writes a new file under `dest` (or the system temp directory); it never overwrites an existing file. The owner sees every item this agent sends with the >_ agent mark and this agent's name, on every device.

dest.description: Where to write a file. A directory means "inside it". Defaults to a fresh temporary directory.

name: zas_get_item
